name: slotPool
meaning: pool of count 0xC-byte float particle positions (Emitter_AddParticle 0x52c70d imul ecx,ecx,0xc stride); memcpy'd wholesale into the D3D vertex buffer by Emitter_Render

name: particles
meaning: pool of count 8-byte particle records {u32 colour; u32 flags}

name: lastSpawnTime
meaning: emitter clock at the last spawn call; 0 = none yet (Sfx_SpawnBillboard 0x52c79a cmp [eax+8],0; 0x52c9cd store)

name: spawnCursor
meaning: time of the last particle spawned (Sfx_SpawnBillboard 0x52c89b add [ebp+0x18]; ja - unsigned)

name: lastSrc
meaning: source position at the last spawn call, as floats (Sfx_SpawnBillboard 0x52c99e fstp [eax+0x14])

name: sheetIndex
meaning: index into the 0x34-stride sprite-sheet table at 0x6d8078; 0xFF = unset

name: count
meaning: number of particle slots; set from the allocator's argument

name: flags
meaning: bit 0 = emitter active/visible (EmitterFlagBits.active); cleared by Emitter_Reset, tested by Emitter_Render and Wolf_ClearEffects
